We need to correctly format the tool call. Let's do:

<thought>We will search for templates that form aliphatic carboxylic acid and C-C double bonds.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=CC(=O)O",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid", "C-C double bonds"],
  "limit": 10
}</action_input>

Let's try.
